question: What follows if consciousness is sought to be cut off?
premises: Cutting consciousness off from things means loss of its nature as consciousness
If consciousness loses its nature as consciousness it perishes
Consciousness flees away if one tries to divide it
inference: Any attempt to cut consciousness off destroys consciousness itself.
plain_english: Therefore, from the loss of its nature as consciousness, this consciousness perishes; for if one seeks to cut consciousness off, it flees away.
